name: P7 - ATANOR decision layer with a language model as reading tool
user_decisions: direction (b); the model only extracts quote-backed fact candidates from excerpts ATANOR chose; goal interpretation, next search/visit, source trust, adopt/hold and actions are ATANOR decisions; model-on and model-off evaluated together; model-read results are not counted as ATANOR learning language; report model version/digest, calls and cost; if results are low, do not widen the model role - report the failure point

model.name: qwen2.5:7b-instruct
model.runtime: Ollama 0.40.3, separate server on 127.0.0.1:11435 with its own model folder (the existing user Ollama store reports every manifest as unreadable; left untouched)

atanor_state.note: H6-1 trained state; no new training in P7; teacher off

pool.rule: Wikidata file formats with one English label, unused in P6 training/dev, H6 transfer and P6 pools

draw: 32 evaluation formats = random.Random(int(sha256(public freeze commit hash)) mod 2^31).sample(sorted(pool), 32)

sealed_sentences.written_by: agent without the teacher context; original published after the run

conditions.S_LM: ATANOR + model, first trusted page (no agreement)

primary: strict completion on possible tasks; F_LM vs N (with tool) and F vs N (model off), paired by task

verdicts.verdict_with_tool: computed for F_LM; credited to ATANOR + reading tool, NOT to ATANOR language
verdicts.verdict_model_off: computed for F; the only one that can support a claim that ATANOR learned something

invalid_if: any model call in a model-off condition
LLM/localhost host requested through the web body
secondary: stop reasons (no evidence / single source / contradiction)
F_LM vs S_LM (value of the agreement rule)
model calls, tokens, GPU seconds, verification rejections
expectation_before_run: From the model-on dev check (44 never-taught formats): adoption recall 0.20 at precision 1.0 (9 correct, 0 wrong), interpretation 0.82, 669 model calls. Whole-task completion needs all 3 files correct, so expected F_LM completion is near 0: verdict_with_tool NO_GAIN expected; verdict_model_off NO_GAIN expected. Wrong placements expected near 0 for F_LM; S_LM may misplace.
known_limits: 7B model, 4-bit; single prompt version; no retries
excerpt choice is a fixed ATANOR rule
search entry points remain Wikimedia/Wiby/direct pages
accepted names are single Wikidata labels
